verdict.rationale: Warp documents a public REST HTTPS+JSON API with API-key authentication, pagination, rate limiting, typed TypeScript and Go SDKs, and a broad endpoint reference. The docs also explicitly support documentation-aware AI tools, and a probe confirmed a live llms.txt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API, a reachable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and clarity on the production 'advanced API module' gated to Enterprise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: REST: a standard HTTPS + JSON API you can use from any language or HTTP client.
The Warp API uses API keys to authenticate requests. Include your API key in the `x-api-key` header on every request.
give documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition
Use the TypeScript SDK (warp-hr) or Go SDK (github.com/TeamWarp/warp-go-sdk) for authentication, pagination, retries, error handling, and webhook verification.
